newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banco de Mexico net assets up, reserves down.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Mexico net assets up, reserves down.

text.p: Banco de Mexico said Tuesday its net international assets as of February 7 were $8.780 billion, compared to $8.758 billion on January 31.
The central bank said that its net international reserves as of February 7 were $18.809 billion, compared to $18.960 billion as of January 31.
The central bank said the increase of $22 million in net international assets in the same time period was due to:
--Net income from operations by the state oil company Pemex worth $292 million.
--Net sales of foreign currency to the federal government worth $207 million for debt-servicing payments.

--A net loss of $63 million dollars for a combination of factors including changes in the dollar value of non-dollar assets and liabilities held by the bank; net returns on interest rates and from trading of metals and securities; and net deposits in dollar accounts from commercial banks at the central bank.

Banco de Mexico said it paid $123 million of debt payments to the International Monetary Fund during the week between January 31 and February 7. It said the payment did not affect net international assets given that the central bank's liabilities with the IMF fell in equal amount to the payment.
Banco de Mexico said that during the week the monetary base fell by 1.689 billion pesos due to a fall in the seasonal demand for bills and coins.
The federal government's deposits in the central bank rose 366 million pesos due to the difference between tax receipts and government spending.

The central bank reduced its credit to financial intermediaries by 743 million pesos in order to compensate for the various factors such as the federal government's operations and the reduction of the monetary base.
The following tables detail Banco de Mexico's reserves and net domestic credit. All figures are in billions of pesos, unless otherwise indicated.
Jan 31 Feb 7
International Reserves
U.S. Dollars $18.960 bln $18.809 bln
Monetary Base 76.721 75.032
Net International Assets*
U.S. Dollars $8.758 bln $8.780 bln
Net Domestic Credit 8.222 6.507
*Net International Assets are defined as gross international assets minus central bank liabilities with the IMF and assets of less than a six-month duration from other central banks.
